notes.title: Earthshine. Games of light and shadow
notes.notes: In the update to the Earthshine visual novel, we have added two romantic scenes with the main characters of the game - Inar and Talia. You can not only enjoy the new arts of Elleiv, but also practice your attentiveness, since one of the scenes became the basis for a new puzzle (DLC Moonbeam), and the second is for the find the differences minigame. Have a nice game!

notes.title: The visual novel Memory Note is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Friends! The visual novel Memory Note is now available on Steam! A fascinating story about two completely different people awaits you. The main hero has an absolute memory, but has a lot of problems with it. But one day he meets a girl who is not able to remember yesterday. What will come of this meeting? Will it become fateful or will it remain fleeting? Open our Memory Note to find out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321040/Memory_Note/

notes.title: Earthshine: Moonbeam DLC is now available
notes.notes:
Dear friends! We are pleased to announce that the Earthshine: Moonbeam DLC is already available.
DLC contains an additional mini-game, desktop wallpapers 1920*1080 and the official soundtrack in flac format.

Tracklist:
1. Two souls (2.38)
2. Magic Way (3.09)
